purpose: City-specific cadastral-source research; findings are limited to observed first-party evidence.
name: Chittoor

queries.query: Chittoor Andhra Pradesh official cadastral parcel map land records GIS MeeBhoomi
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the Government of Andhra Pradesh Bhunaksha cadastral mapping viewer, the official Chittoor district administration site, and its Mee Bhoomi revenue-services link. The Bhunaksha result describes a public cadastral mapping service with geo-referenced spatial data, but no parcel response was obtained in this bounded attempt.

queries.query: చిత్తూరు భూమి రికార్డులు అధికారిక మ్యాప్ మీభూమి
queries.result: Telugu first-party discovery returned the Andhra Pradesh land-records context and confirmed that MeeBhoomi is the state revenue land-records portal; the official Tirupati district Telugu service page also describes MeeBhoomi. No safe Chittoor parcel geometry or native parcel identity was returned.

registryEvidence.custodian: Government of Andhra Pradesh, Department of Survey, Settlements and Land Records; Chittoor district administration; MeeBhoomi revenue service
